content: crypto-js README now carries a Discontinued notice: active development discontinued, library no longer maintained; recommends native crypto. PBKDF2 in crypto-js is synchronous - issue #213 reports UI thread freeze in browsers even at 100 SHA512 iterations; no async variant exists. On Hermes (no JIT), pure-JS PBKDF2 at 100k iterations is expected to take multiple seconds and AES of a 10MB payload likely exceeds a 2s budget; no reliable published mobile benchmark found (LOW confidence on exact timings - must benchmark on device). Pure-JS alternatives: @noble/hashes pbkdf2 is faster, audited, maintained.
